approved_scope: all six frozen arms, all real main-rollout tokens
duplicate_source_identity_rule: preserve all source_row_ids for byte-identical problem/solution; no content dedup in training or observations
stop_union: primary engine EOS plus inherited generation eos_token_id extras; verified again at each live trainer init
overlap_definition: size(Top100(student) intersection Top100(teacher))/100, includes special tokens; not Jaccard or probability mass
entropy_definition: full-vocabulary Shannon -sum p*ln(p), p=softmax(detached logits at T=1), nats, FP32, no sampling truncation
eos_logp_gap_sign: teacher minus student; each stop ID separate
actual_token_logp: separate sampled-token quantity, not entropy; same aligned full distribution
position_alignment: incoming author compute_loss [prompt_length-1:-1]; sampled IDs and labels [prompt_length:]; no second shift
real_token_support: raw vLLM token_ids, including actual terminal pad-ID token; exclude physical padding only by raw length
loss_support: original labels != -100 stored separately, no change; mask-mapped real EOS retained as observed token with false loss mask
stop_event_rule: finish_reason stop natural; length right-censored even if final ID is EOS; raw stop_reason and eos_events both retained
normalization: raw arrays only; summaries must separately name all-real vs loss-valid support and token vs response weighting
auxiliary_replay: existing aux-replay records separate; this monitor does not add/recompute replay forwards or merge their denominators
sampling: none; every optimizer microbatch/rank/response/real token retained
storage: one atomic gzip JSON per rank/microbatch/launch segment; no overwrite; checkpoint/resume selects committed prefix without deleting history
passivity: detach+no_grad existing logits; no extra model forward, no RNG calls, no in-place mutation, original loss expression untouched
smoke_gate: existing T0 and T6_ON_T1_MAIN DP4 2step->native resume3step plus adapter canonical smoke; monitor schema/fullness/RNG/cost required
cost_bounds: max 3200 main responses and 3276800 real tokens per arm at step100; no full-logit archive; compressed metric arrays plus prompt/source IDs
